backtest_protocol.cross_asset_context_source: warehouse_main.sqlite plus warehouse_main_hot.sqlite repaired factor ETF rows
backtest_protocol.execution_model: SPY, MTUM, QUAL, VLUE, USMV, SIZE, and candidate stock features are computed from OHLCV rows with Date <= signal_date. Rolling factor betas are fit on the 60 trading-day period ending 20 sessions before signal date; the 20-day residual leadership window ends at signal date. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay
